title: Depth-Aware Allocator (K454 Phase 5 HIGH, v6.20 Capacity Rescue, 21st Daemon)
k454_problem: Linear AUM scaling = quadratic slippage if all positions on single venue (HL OI cap breach)
k458_solution: Distribute across venues respecting 5% OI cap per venue; greedy allocator by venue score

functions.fetch_venue_depth: Live OI + L2 book depth (HL l2Book + metaAndAssetCtxs, Bybit orderbook + tickers, OKX books + open-interest)
functions.compute_max_position_per_venue: 5% of OI cap per venue (floor: min_depth_usd check)
functions.distribute_target: Greedy allocation: score venues → fill caps → reduce if over-capacity
functions.recommend_reduce: If remaining > 0: reduce target to min(cap, slippage-safe) size
functions.submit_allocation_post_only: K439 POST_ONLY scaffold per venue allocation
functions.run_aum_simulation: $100M simulation: without allocator (HL dump) vs with allocator (distributed)

without_allocator.verdict: BAD at scale — quadratic regime above 5% OI

with_allocator.verdict: GOOD — distributed below 5% OI per venue

integration.K434_smart_router: Venue scoring patterns (rebate+depth+cap) reused; K458 operates above K434
integration.K456_okx: OKX as 3rd active venue in allocator
